name: Spectral Decay Rate
description: Measures how fast frequency spectrum decays
algorithm: Spectral Decay Rate — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes the frequency domain characteristics of the image:

1. **Transform**: The image is decomposed using frequency-domain transforms (FFT/DCT/Wavelet).

2. **Spectral Analysis**: Measures how fast frequency spectrum decays. Frequency components are analyzed for patterns characteristic of AI generation.

3. **Band Separation**: Energy distribution across frequency bands is measured and compared.

4. **Artifact Detection**: AI-specific frequency signatures are identified through statistical comparison.

5. **Scoring**: Results are normalized to a 0-100 confidence score.
parameters:
Analysis type: frequency
Media: image
Input: Raw pixel data / image file
Output: Confidence score (0-100)
Processing: Client-side Canvas API
Color spaces: RGB, Grayscale as applicable
accuracy: Moderate to High — 70-90% standalone accuracy. Performance is highest on uncompressed images and may decrease with heavy JPEG compression or social media re-encoding.
source: Digital image forensics research. Based on signal processing and computational photography principles.
useCase: Detection of AI-generated or manipulated images through spectral decay rate analysis. This method identifies patterns and artifacts that are characteristic of AI generation, contributing to a comprehensive image forensic analysis.
strengths:
• Fast client-side processing using Canvas API
• Effective at detecting specific AI generation artifacts
• Works with common image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
• Can be combined with complementary analysis methods
• Based on established image forensics research
limitations:
• Performance may vary with image compression level
• Social media re-encoding can affect accuracy
• Best used in combination with other forensic methods
• May produce false positives on heavily processed authentic images
• Effectiveness depends on the AI generation model used
